pairs.subject: guest-execution-bounding
pairs.evidence: src/features/notepad/notepadActions.ts:1 The notepad context is a UI scratchpad with a debounced persistence store and dispatch doors that send notes to Athena, Fleet and Goals through IPC. It embeds no interpreter and runs no guest code in-process. A case-insensitive search of src/features/notepad found zero hits for interpreter, quickjs, guest, sandbox and wasm, and the only 'new Function' hit was a code comment ('new function every render'), not a call. So the subject's precondition (a host evaluating guest code inside its own dispatch loop or an embedded engine) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: src/features/notepad/notepadActions.ts:11 Agent work is handed out of process to the companion/fleet backend. No third-party engine is embedded here whose loop would need an external terminator.

src/features/notepad/notepadStore.ts:336 The only work this context schedules on the host executor is a per-note 500 ms debounced save. There is no guest evaluation to charge a cost budget against or make yield.
src/features/notepad/notepadActions.ts:7 Errors here are IPC dispatch failures routed to toastCatch. No runtime limit breach exists that a guest handler could intercept.
src/features/notepad/cardMarkdown.ts:21 Card markdown is a fixed regex subset translated to HTML, not a compiled guest language with loops to count.
